CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "qti"."__refuse"("state" "pg_catalog"."text", "constraint_name" "pg_catalog"."text", "detail" "pg_catalog"."text") RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE PARALLEL SAFE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = "pg_catalog", "pg_temp"
AS $$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'grizzle refused the statement'
    USING ERRCODE = "state",
          CONSTRAINT = "constraint_name",
          DETAIL = "detail";
END
$$
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION "qti"."__refuse"("pg_catalog"."text", "pg_catalog"."text", "pg_catalog"."text") FROM PUBLIC

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "qti"."__require_serializable"() RETURNS "pg_catalog"."trigger"
LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = "pg_catalog", "pg_temp"
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF "pg_catalog"."current_setting"('transaction_isolation'::"pg_catalog"."text") <> 'serializable'::"pg_catalog"."text" THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'a write to a grizzle table requires SERIALIZABLE'
      USING ERRCODE = 'invalid_transaction_state'::"pg_catalog"."text",
            SCHEMA = TG_TABLE_SCHEMA,
            TABLE = TG_TABLE_NAME,
            HINT = 'write at SERIALIZABLE'::"pg_catalog"."text";
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END
$$
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION "qti"."__require_serializable"() FROM PUBLIC

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "qti"."__snapshot_guard"("fingerprint" "pg_catalog"."text") RETURNS "pg_catalog"."void"
LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = "pg_catalog", "pg_temp"
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "qti"."__ledger" AS "r1" WHERE "r1"."ordinal" = 0 AND "r1"."files" <> (SELECT "pg_catalog"."count"(*) FROM "qti"."__ledger" AS "r2" WHERE "r2"."folder" = "r1"."folder" AND "r2"."ordinal" <> 0)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'a grizzle migration of this schema is running or stopped part-way'
      USING ERRCODE = '55Z02'::"pg_catalog"."text";
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "qti"."__ledger" AS "r3" WHERE "r3"."ordinal" = 0 AND "r3"."target" = "fingerprint" AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "qti"."__ledger" AS "r4" WHERE "r4"."ordinal" = 0 AND "r4"."folder" > "r3"."folder")) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'the latest grizzle migration of this schema is not the snapshot of this Db'
      USING ERRCODE = '55Z01'::"pg_catalog"."text";
  END IF;
END
$$
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION "qti"."__snapshot_guard"("pg_catalog"."text") FROM PUBLIC
